games.name: Wario Land: Super Mario Land 3
games.description: Edits three 0x40-byte slots and repairs their independent additive checksums at 0xC0-0xC2. Course completion is read-only because its derived packed-BCD count is not refreshed. Gold, lives, hearts, and completion count expose raw packed-BCD storage; decoded three-byte gold is omitted.
